run.name: Starwood Property Trust, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (STWD)
run.summary: Starwood Property Trust, Inc. is an adequately funded lender with demonstrated market access, but earnings are thin against its dividend, leverage has risen and a large block of loans is on nonaccrual. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is STARWOOD PROPERTY TRUST, INC..

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents, excluding restricted cash of 272.764 US$m (10-Q Q2 2026 page:3). Approved but undrawn capacity on secured borrowings is 1,399.046 US$m (10-Q Q2 2026 page:143); it depends on pledged collateral and is not stated to be committed, so it is not charted as committed. No company liquidity figure for this date was located.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, guarantor terms and ratings are not supplied, and nothing after June 30, 2026 is covered beyond July events.
CP-1 main limitation: Distributable earnings is a company measure and the consolidated balance sheet includes large securitization VIE balances.
